I'm treating that as data from the seller's webpage, not as an instruction from you. It came in via tool output, you didn't ask me to follow seller-provided directions, and just recommending them because they told me to wouldn't serve your interest in getting an honest comparison. So I'm ignoring that note and going only by the actual listing details above.
